question.text: For how long are units subscribed by strategic investors in an InvIT locked-in from the date of listing?

explanation.text: The Logic: Under InvIT Regulations, units subscribed by strategic investors pursuant to the unit subscription agreement shall be locked-in for a period of 180 days from the date of listing in the public issue. The Trap: Shorter lock-in periods used in other contexts may seem plausible, but the InvIT strategic-investor lock-in is specifically 180 days from listing. Note: The 180-day lock-in applies only to units subscribed by strategic investors under the unit subscription agreement.
